stem.text: In an experiment, a student uses a microphone and a cathode-ray oscilloscope (CRO) to analyse a sound wave. The diagram shows the trace on the screen of the CRO.

stem.alt: Screen of a cathode-ray oscilloscope with a grid, showing a curved trace running from the lower left to the upper right.

stem.text: The student is expecting a sinusoidal waveform to be shown on the screen.
Which changes should the student make to the time-base and the $y$-gain of the CRO so that the screen shows a continuous trace for one complete cycle of the waveform?
